    Restrict Unix local MCP servers to stdio descriptors (#47094)
    
    ## Why
    
    Local MCP servers communicate over stdio, so unrelated parent file descriptors should not propagate into the server or its descendants.
    
    ## What changed
    
    Apply `DescriptorPolicy::StdioOnly` when launching local stdio MCP servers on Unix, preserving their explicit transport stdio.
    
    ## Testing
    
    Add Unix integration tests that check inheritable pipe, socket, and file descriptors are absent from servers and descendants across absolute, relative, and shell-fallback launches. Verify MCP communication, arguments, environment, working directory, parent descriptor ownership, and exec failure reporting remain intact.
